title: Recovery sleep induces analgesia via sleep ensembles of the zona incerta acting through distinct neural circuits in mice
title_zh: 恢复性睡眠通过 zona incerta 的睡眠集群在小鼠中诱导镇痛，且通过不同神经回路实现
abstract: Recovery sleep alleviates pain in humans, yet the underlying neural mechanisms remain elusive. Here, we identify a population of sleep-activated neuronal ensembles within the zona incerta (ZI) that mediate both non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep and analgesia. Optrode recordings revealed preferential activity of these sleep ensembles during NREM sleep, whereas chronic pain markedly attenuated their activity. Activation of these ensembles increased NREM sleep and reduced pain sensitivity, whereas their inhibition reversed these effects. Gene profiling revealed enriched expression of neurotensin (NTS) within these neurons, and NTS knockdown significantly blunted their sleep-promoting and analgesic functions. Furthermore, ZI sleep ensembles project divergently to the lateral hypothalamus (LH) and the posterior thalamic nucleus (PO). ZI NTS projections to the LH specifically regulate NREM sleep without affecting nociception, whereas projections to the PO selectively mediate analgesia without impacting sleep. Collectively, these findings reveal that ZI sleep ensembles mediate recovery-sleep-induced analgesia, achieving modality specificity through segregated downstream targets.
abstract_zh: 恢复性睡眠可缓解人类疼痛，但其潜在神经机制仍不清楚。我们在 zona incerta（ZI）中鉴定了一群在睡眠中被激活的神经元集群，既介导非快速眼动睡眠（NREM），又产生镇痛作用。光电记录显示这些睡眠集群在 NREM 睡眠期间的活性显著增强，而慢性疼痛则明显抑制其活性。激活这些集群可增加 NREM 睡眠并降低疼痛敏感性，抑制则相反。基因表达分析发现这些神经元中神经肽 NTS 的表达显著升高，敲低 NTS 可显著削弱其促睡眠和镇痛功能。此外，ZI 睡眠集群向侧下丘脑（LH）和后丘脑核（PO）分别投射。ZI NTS 投射到 LH 主要调节 NREM 睡眠而不影响痛觉感知，而投射到 PO 则专门介导镇痛而不影响睡眠。综上所述，这些结果表明 ZI 睡眠集群通过分离的下游靶点实现恢复性睡眠诱导的镇痛，并实现功能特异性。
